WITH pedidos AS (
  SELECT v.order_id, v.customer_state, AVG(rv.review_score) AS calificacion, 
         julianday(v.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(v.order_estimated_delivery_date) AS dias_retraso
  FROM vw_pedidos_validos v
  JOIN order_reviews rv ON rv.order_id = v.order_id
  WHERE v.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND rv.review_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY v.order_id, v.customer_state
),
rangos AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN dias_retraso <= 0 THEN 'a tiempo'
    WHEN dias_retraso <= 3 THEN '1-3'
    WHEN dias_retraso <= 7 THEN '4-7'
    WHEN dias_retraso <= 14 THEN '8-14'
    ELSE '15+'
  END AS rango, COUNT(*) AS pedidos, AVG(calificacion) AS calificacion_promedio
  FROM pedidos GROUP BY rango
),
porcentajes AS (
  SELECT rango, pedidos, calificacion_promedio,
         ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN calificacion <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / pedidos, 2) AS pct_2_o_menos
  FROM rangos GROUP BY rango
),
atimo AS (
  SELECT rango, pedidos, calificacion_promedio, pct_2_o_menos,
         ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN calificacion <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / pedidos, 2) AS pct_2_o_menos_atimo

WITH 
pv AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT oi.seller_id, v.order_id FROM order_items oi JOIN vw_pedidos_validos v ON v.order_id = oi.order_id
),
ing AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS ingresos FROM order_items oi JOIN vw_pedidos_validos v ON v.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE v.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
cal AS (
  SELECT pv.seller_id FROM pv LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, AVG(review_score) AS calif FROM order_reviews GROUP BY order_id) r ON r.order_id = pv.order_id
  GROUP BY pv.seller_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 AND AVG(r.calif) IS NOT NULL
),
tar AS (
  SELECT pv.seller_id FROM pv JOIN (SELECT order_id, CASE WHEN julianday(order_delivered_customer_date) > julianday(order_estimated_delivery_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tarde FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL) t ON t.order_id = pv.order_id
  GROUP BY pv.seller_id HAVING SUM(t.tarde) / COUNT(*) > 0.15
),
top_ing AS (
  SELECT seller_id, ingresos FROM ing ORDER BY ingresos DESC LIMIT 25
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS vendedores, SUM(ingresos) AS ingresos FROM top_ing JOIN cal ON top_ing.seller_id = cal.seller_id JOIN tar ON top_ing.seller_id = tar.seller_id

WITH pp AS (
  SELECT oi.order_id, t.product_category_name_english AS categoria, MAX(op.payment_installments) AS cuotas
  FROM vw_pedidos_validos v
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = v.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
  JOIN order_payments op ON op.order_id = v.order_id
  WHERE op.payment_type != 'not_defined'
  GROUP BY oi.order_id, t.product_category_name_english
),
pp2 AS (
  SELECT categoria, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS pedidos, SUM(CASE WHEN cuotas > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pagados_a_plazos
  FROM pp GROUP BY categoria
)
SELECT categoria, pedidos, ROUND(100.0 * pagados_a_plazos / pedidos, 2) AS pct_a_plazos
FROM pp2
WHERE pedidos >= 100
ORDER BY pct_a_plazos DESC LIMIT 1
